description: The source is a flat mauve 0x8060a0 -- three channels, all mid-range and all different -- so every knob moves it visibly and none of them moves it by accident. Vignette at 0.8 leaves the centre alone and takes the corners most of the way to black, falling off with the square of the distance. This is the one grade property whose output is not a flat colour, so it is the only fixture that would catch a falloff measured from the frame rather than the layer, or a linear ramp instead of a squared one.
